privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset 'ne_countries' corresponds to the Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 Countries dataset. While the task description asks for an abstract mentioning 'sovereign states', the actual dataset contains 258 entries including dependent territories. The VLM should strictly verify that the agent entered the text exactly as requested in the task description: Title: 'World Political Boundaries (1:110m)'; Abstract: 'Country boundaries from the Natural Earth 1:110 million scale cultural dataset. Includes sovereign states and dependent territories with administrative boundary polygons suitable for small-scale thematic mapping and reference cartography.'; Keywords: 'countries', 'political', 'boundaries', 'natural-earth', 'admin-0'. The Declared SRS must be exactly 'EPSG:4326'.
